title: Booked hire licences and booking entities (Queensland)
summary: From 1 October 2017 Queensland licensed booked hire services and booking entities, completing the legal framework for ride-share alongside taxis.

instruments.title: Transport and Other Legislation (Personalised Transport Reform) Amendment Act 2017

commenced.what: Booked hire licences and booking entity authorisation commenced

direction_rationale: A licence for booked hire lets new operators and platforms supply point-to-point transport alongside capped taxi licences.
comparison: Other states after their own point-to-point reforms (extends the ride-share family)

verified.notes: Read on the Queensland register (Act as made and proclamation SL 2017 No 142).
